STEP 6. Check the combination meter (printed-circuit 
board).
(1) Remove the combination meter.
(2) Remove the seat belt warning light bulb. Then measure the 
resistance between the bulb terminals. 
(3) Install the bulb to the combination meter, and then measure 
the resistance between connector C-41 terminal 52 and 
connector C-42 terminal 26. The resistance reading at this 
time should be much the same as the resistance measured 
at Step (2). 
Q: Are the two resistance values extremely different each 
other?
YES : Repair or replace the combination meter (printed 
circuit board). The seat belt warning light should work 
normally. 
NO (much the same) : Go to Step 7.
STEP 7. Check combination meter connector C-42 and 
ETACS-ECU Connector C-111 for damage.
Q: Is combination meter connector C-42 and ETACS-ECU 
connector C111 in good condition?
YES : Go to Step 9.
NO : Repair or replace it. Refer to GROUP 00E, Harness 
Connector Inspection P.00E-2. The seat belt warning 
light should work normally.
